methods.name: Turael
methods.note: Burthorpe. Easy, fast tasks but poor XP and no points. Used to start out, to boost points between milestone tasks and to swap out a bad task.

methods.name: Krystilia (Wilderness)
methods.note: Edgeville. Wilderness-only tasks worth 25 points each, the most of any master. Any combat level but can assign hard tasks. Only risk gear you can lose.

methods.name: Mazchna
methods.note: Canifis. 6 points a task. A step up from Turael and usable for point boosting.

methods.name: Vannaka
methods.note: Edgeville Dungeon. 8 points a task. Can assign tough tasks like blue dragons at low level, so leave combat level checking on.

methods.name: Chaeldar
methods.note: Zanaris. 10 points a task. Where the guide says a mid-level account at 70 combat can start.

methods.name: Konar quo Maten
methods.note: Mount Karuulm. 18 points a task and each task is tied to one location. Use her for milestone tasks. The only master who assigns hydras.

methods.name: Nieve or Steve
methods.note: Tree Gnome Stronghold. 12 points a task. Similar list to Duradel with a few weaker tasks such as brine rats and scabarites.

methods.name: Duradel
methods.note: Shilo Village. Best master for XP. Tasks the guide says to do run from 30k to 150k an hour with cannon and barrage. 15 points a task.

methods.name: Mortimer
methods.note: Wyrmscraig Cavern. Offers a choice of tasks, all with superior variants, plus modifiers. No points unless a modifier gives them. Skips cost 100 points.

unverified: All masters: neither Slayer training nor Ironman Guide/Slayer gives a Slayer XP rate per master, only per task for Duradel's list, so every xph is 0

Duradel: per-task rates in the guide's task summary (cannon, venator bow or barrage) for tasks marked Do are ankou 55,000, araxytes 100,000, bloodveld 80,000-100,000, black dragons 30,000, dagannoth 85,000, dark beasts 42,000, dust devils 100,000-110,000, kalphites 75,000, nechryael 100,000, smoke devils 150,000, suqah 55,000, trolls 50,000, TzHaar 100,000

Duradel: the Ironman Guide (no cannon) gives lower task rates, for example smoke devils 75,000-80,000, greater nechryael 75,000-95,000, dust devils 65,000-85,000, dagannoth 30,000 melee, dark beasts about 30,000
Every master except Turael and Krystilia can also be used at 99 Slayer regardless of combat level, which req cannot express
Krystilia: requirement is 'any level (done at least 1 task)'

Mortimer: only partial completion of Fallen From Grace is needed; 62 Sailing is the Wyrmscraig requirement mentioned in the guide's wyrm rows, not on Mortimer's own page; the Mortimer page (fetched) gives no XP rate
Nieve or Steve: points rise to Duradel's 15 with the elite Western Provinces diary; Konar's rise to 20 with the elite Kourend and Kebos diary
Not included: Spria (same tier as Turael, needs A Porcine of Interest) and Temple Trekking (5,800-7,800 Slayer XP an hour from reward tomes)
